title: Run the model download tests in the app test runner

proofs.run: sh scripts/swift-test-here.sh --filter MeaningModelStoreTests, then again with --filter LayaModelStoreDownload (a tree whose library matches; needs 8 GB free and load under 30); quote the last `Test run with N tests` line of each and name every failing test
proofs.pass: each run ends `Test run with N tests ... passed` (N 9 for MeaningModelStoreTests, 1 for LayaModelStoreDownload) and lists no failing test; a failing test is copied by name

notes: Package.swift:53-56 declares the test target WhooshTests with path "Tests", which holds Tests/Unit/MeaningModelStoreTests.swift and LayaModelStoreDownloadTests.swift. MeaningModelStoreTests has nine @Test functions (lines 50, 69, 80, 93, 109, 130, 145, 170, 184); LayaModelStoreDownloadTests is one @Suite with one @Test (lines 8-9: downloadShowsProgressFailsInWordsAndRetries). The reader's older log (unit-final.log, 232 tests, 45 issues) ran no MeaningModelStore suite; whether the suite is compiled into the target now is what proof 3 shows. `Test run with N tests` is printed by swift test; scripts/swift-test-here.sh prints the last such line itself (its header). The proof 3 N values are an expectation of the lead's reading, not a machine check.
